description: This is a PHPUnit test case class for the OrangeHRM project, providing utility methods for testing including reflection-based invocation of private and protected methods, and integration with EntityManagerTrait.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending PHPUnit's TestCase, providing utility methods for reflection and mock testing within the OrangeHRM test suite.

methods.name: getEntityReference
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to an entity by name and ID using the EntityManagerTrait.

methods.name: getClassMethod
methods.description: Uses reflection to access a method of a class and makes it accessible for invocation.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethod
methods.description: Invokes a private method of a class instance, creating an instance if needed.

methods.name: invokePrivateMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a private method on a mock object.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethod
methods.description: Invokes a protected method of a class, similar to invokePrivateMethod.

methods.name: invokeProtectedMethodOnMock
methods.description: Invokes a protected method on a mock object.
